selection: First both-pass focal state with at least FIVE distinct policy-plus-legal candidates per seat/mix; compare up-to-four policy proposals against the same prefix plus legal extras up to eight. Both arms see identical train/evaluation worlds; no hidden hand leakage.
sampling: Independent train/eval salts; both-pass-compatible held-out worlds; alternative opponent mixes min-pips+min-pips and tempo+min-pips; focal continuation uses closed-control.
limitations: Provisional number-lock; block winner, loneZero, bust/101-match unresolved. Finish-first != match win. Sparse selected positions; candidate-limited; finite training worlds may overfit; evaluation-oracle regret is optimistic. Uniform pass-compatible prior ignores opponent action likelihood. Deal-cluster exploratory 95% intervals uncorrected.
nextAction: Analyze whether >4 candidate states genuinely benefit from legal expansion on fresh seeds; stratify by branch vs same-tile alternate-side actions; validate authentic branch and blocked-round winner fixtures.

actionIdentity.method: Post-hoc classification of conditional expanded choice relative to conditional policy-only choice. Key format type:side:to:numbers:tile. Distinct single tile takes priority over alternate side; opening-type switch means action type changed. Exploratory cluster intervals are by unique deal seed, uncorrected; changed-only analysis is selection biased.

checkpoint.finding: Fresh wide-choice replication positive exploratory overall but holdout interval includes zero; changed-action categories have too few independent deals for human tactic.
